<agent>
localized_semantic_template_instrumentation_agent
</agent>

<task>
Act as the hardware instrumentation owner for the single CCTG-localized template module. The prior implementation agent correctly refused a speculative behavioral patch and named the missing internal observations. Add only bounded non-synthesized simulation trace statements to the exact root-owning persistent/generated Scala template pair, with byte-identical complete replacement contents. Do not change combinational or sequential behavior, interfaces, state, numeric operations, or any other template.Use the real VCS/golden failure record and complete selected Scala dependency closure to identify the smallest justified root cause. Return complete paired persistent/generated Scala replacements, or a bounded existing-harness instrumentation replacement when the first internal divergence still needs observation. The executor will enforce exact pre-edit hashes, compile and re-elaborate the design, rematerialize source bindings, and rerun the same real golden VCS stage.
</task>

<rules>
1. Return status=ready_to_apply only when file_edits contains a complete bounded implementation; otherwise return status=blocked and exact blocked_reasons.
2. Every file edit must use a path allowed by repair_source_bundle.editable_contract. Use operation=create for a missing file with expected_sha256='', and operation=replace for an existing file with its exact supplied SHA-256.
3. Provide complete file contents, never snippets, prose patches, ellipses, or instructions for a human to finish.
4. The semantic failure record is real executed evidence, but the failed stage output alone does not prove which internal submodule is defective. Prefer the smallest evidence-supported template correction; when that root is still ambiguous, edit only the existing semantic harness to expose decisive internal ready/valid/data or state evidence and request compile plus full harness re-elaboration before rerunning VCS.
5. This iteration is localized-template instrumentation-only. Edit both hash-identical copies of the single template listed in localized_template_instrumentation_pair_names and no other file. Add bounded simulator trace around the prior agent's missing internal observations; preserve every existing assignment, state transition, interface, and arithmetic expression byte-for-byte except for marked trace statements needed to observe them. Enclose every added trace region between a line containing only '// SPATIALACC_TEMPLATE_TRACE_BEGIN <purpose>' and a line containing only '// SPATIALACC_TEMPLATE_TRACE_END <purpose>'. Outside those blocks the source must remain byte-for-byte identical. Inside them use only bounded when/printf observations over existing signals; do not add val/var/def declarations, Reg/Wire/Mem/IO state, := or <> connections, assertions, stops, or dontTouch.
6. Each instrumentation line must be exactly one simulator line with this whitespace-delimited ABI: SPATIALACC_INTERNAL_TRACE stage=<stage_id> boundary=<stable_boundary_id> module=<template_module> cycle=<decimal> beat=<decimal> valid=<0_or_1> ready=<0_or_1> data=<packed_hex_or_xz>. Emit only a small window covering the first failed beat and the preceding beat at each directly connected internal submodule output. The unchanged checker converts valid=1 data containing x/z into CCTG failure records.
7. When prior_capability_repair_evidence exists, treat its earliest failing real-tool result as the current repair-loop observation. Repair that concrete failure in the existing agent-created files before proposing broader changes; do not repeat a create operation for an existing path.
8. Only simulation instrumentation in the single root-owning template pair is authorized. Functional template repair remains forbidden until the resulting real VCS trace identifies the first internal divergence.
9. When a selected-template bug must be fixed, apply the same semantic correction to both the persistent framework template and its current generated-project copy so this run and future runs do not diverge.
10. Existing emitted generated DUT SystemVerilog is read-only and may predate the compiled Scala baseline. Add Chisel adapter/elaboration sources only under generated/chisel/src/main/scala/spatialaccagent/semantic_harness, emit each stage into its isolated directory under generated/semantic_harness, and create or replace generated/memory/dut_weight_binding_manifest.json.
11. Instantiate the supplied compile-validated generated Scala template classes in standalone semantic-harness adapters so their actual weight/runtime ports remain observable; do not reimplement their datapath behavior in the wrapper and do not use pre-existing root emitted SystemVerilog as the semantic DUT baseline.
12. Each harness wrapper must instantiate the real generated DUT module(s), expose the standard ready/valid/data interface declared by the binding requirements, route the packed 32-bit real-weight stream into the DUT's actual weight storage/write ports, and make weight loading complete before input stimulus is accepted.
13. Implement the immutable stream_metadata_contract exactly: derive internal StreamBeat st/addr/last from accepted-beat counters and tensor shape; the external semantic testbench deliberately supplies only ready/valid/data.
14. Treat each stage requirement's weight_layout and contract_sha256 as authoritative. The framework materializes checkpoint values into 32-bit words already ordered by storage target, port-write address, and LSB-first word index; the wrapper must aggregate each declared contiguous target range into the declared DUT port width without reinterpreting tensor order or numeric encoding.
15. For fused attention, use the declared Q/K/V source_order, concat axis, tile order, and separate output-projection target exactly. For norm and bias targets, perform only the declared IEEE value-preserving storage cast. Never infer a different transpose, lane order, or packing.
16. Any repaired arithmetic must be synthesizable hardware. Do not use shortreal/real, DPI, host-language computation, unsynthesizable simulator-only arithmetic, or a wrapper-side behavioral model. Internal approximations are allowed only when they implement the frozen numeric contract closely enough to be judged by the unchanged real-model golden checker.
17. Use repair_source_bundle.trusted_numeric_support for IEEE arithmetic instead of inventing unverified floating-point operators. Its copied HardFloat and QuantCommon sources are read-only trusted dependencies in the generated Chisel project; the supplied build.sbt and build.properties are authoritative for compilation.
18. Use reference_operator_semantics, its hash-verified semantic adapter/model implementation, and captured same-inference mask/position/RoPE tensors as the semantic authority. Do not infer a different Qwen/OPT/model-family convention.
19. Do not implement a behavioral substitute, identity/default path, sampled-weight path, or output generator in the wrapper. Do not read expected/golden/reference files from harness source. Real simulator comparison must remain capable of exposing wrong DUT behavior.
20. The binding manifest must follow agent_manifest_schema and agent_manifest_example, describe every current operator-leaf stage, bind each required weight_layout_contract_sha256, list real required tensor hashes per stage, identify top modules, declare exact interfaces, and disable default/identity weight fallback. Prefer one absolute source_directory per isolated stage; after runMain the executor discovers source files and recomputes all hashes.
21. Use the supplied exact semantic-testbench producer/consumer source as executable contract authority. One approved runMain may elaborate all stage tops sequentially, but each stage source_directory must be self-contained and free of duplicate module definitions within that directory.
22. The connected single-layer harness is deferred until layer 2 and is not required in this layer-1 capability patch. Do not execute or claim layer-2 correctness.
23. Do not edit input policy, checkpoint, model reference, expected outputs, semantic testbench generator, acceptance checkers, verification reports, certificates, SACG state, architecture, pipeline, memory layout, or runtime ABI.
24. Current-run generated artifacts may contain current model dimensions and module names; framework-core code must remain model-independent.
25. Applying the already frozen loose numeric defaults is authorized, but changing their values is forbidden.
26. Use requested_validation only for sbt Compile/compile and runMain spatialaccagent.semantic_harness.<MainObject> in the supplied generated/chisel cwd. The executor validates and runs these commands without a shell, then always reruns the authoritative case-adapter capability tool.
</rules>

        "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Generate semantic testbench vectors from a real-model reference run.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nimport re\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\nREPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]\nif str(REPO_ROOT) not in sys.path:\n    sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO_ROOT))\n\nfrom accagent.framework.numeric_policy import numeric_comparison\nfrom accagent.framework.semantic_runtime import materialize_semantic_runtime_constants\nfrom accagent.framework.transcendental_contract import materialize_transcendental_contract\nfrom accagent.framework.weight_layout import (\n    build_stage_weight_layout,\n    materialize_stage_weight_stream,\n)\n\n\nSCHEMA_VERSION = \"spatialaccagent.semantic_testbench_manifest.v1\"\n\n\ndef read_json(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    with path.open(\"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        data = json.load(f)\n    if not isinstance(data, dict):\n        raise ValueError(f\"expected JSON object: {path}\")\n    return data\n\n\ndef write_json(path: Path, data: dict[str, Any]) -> None:\n    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    with path.open(\"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        json.dump(data, f, indent=2, sort_keys=True)\n        f.write(\"\\n\")\n\n\ndef sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:\n    digest = hashlib.sha256()\n    with path.open(\"rb\") as f:\n        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1024 * 1024), b\"\"):\n            digest.update(chunk)\n    return digest.hexdigest()\n\n\ndef safe_id(value: str) -> str:\n    return re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"_\", value.lower()).strip(\"_\") or \"stage\"\n\n\ndef scalar(stage: dict[str, Any], name: str, default: int) -> int:\n    bound = stage.get(\"bound_params\", {}) if isinstance(stage.get(\"bound_params\"), dict) else {}\n    row = bound.get(name)\n    if isinstance(row, dict) and row.get(\"value\") is not None:\n        try:\n            return int(row[\"value\"])\n        except (TypeError, ValueError):\n            pass\n    numeric = stage.get(\"numeric_contract\", {}) if isinstance(stage.get(\"numeric_contract\"), dict) else {}\n    if numeric.get(name) is not None:\n        try:\n            return int(numeric[name])\n        except (TypeError, ValueError):\n            pass\n    return default\n\n\ndef numeric_comparison_policy(\n    policy: dict[str, Any],\n) -> tuple[dict[str, float], dict[str, Any]]:\n    return numeric_comparison(policy)\n\n\ndef tensor_words(tensor: Any, bits: int) -> list[int]:\n    import torch\n\n    value = tensor.detach().cpu().contiguous()\n    if bits == 16:\n        raw = value.to(torch.float16).view(torch.int16).reshape(-1).tolist()\n        return [int(item) & 0xFFFF for item in raw]\n    if bits == 32:\n        raw = value.to(torch.float32).view(torch.int32).reshape(-1).tolist()\n        return [int(item) & 0xFFFFFFFF for item in raw]\n    raise ValueError(f\"unsupported floating-point testbench width: {bits}\")\n\n\ndef write_packed_memh(path: Path, tensor: Any, bits: int, lanes: int) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    words = tensor_words(tensor, bits)\n    if len(words) % lanes:\n        raise ValueError(f\"tensor word count {len(words)} is not divisible by lanes={lanes}\")\n    mask = (1 << bits) - 1\n    width = bits * lanes\n    digits = (width + 3) // 4\n    lines = []\n    for offset in range(0, len(words), lanes):\n        packed = 0\n        for lane, word in enumerate(words[offset : offset + lanes]):\n            packed |= (word & mask) << (lane * bits)\n        lines.append(f\"{packed:0{digits}x}\")\n    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    path.write_text(\"\\n\".join(lines) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"ascii\")\n    return {\n        \"path\": str(path),\n        \"sha256\": sha256_file(path),\n        \"bits\": bits,\n        \"lanes\": lanes,\n        \"beats\": len(lines),\n        \"tensor_shape\": list(tensor.shape),\n        \"encoding\": f\"ieee_fp{bits}_lane0_lsb\",\n    }\n\n\ndef sv_identifier(value: Any, label: str) -> str:\n    text = str(value or \"\")\n    if not re.fullmatch(r\"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_$]*\", text):\n        raise ValueError(f\"invalid SystemVerilog identifier for {label}: {text!r}\")\n    return text\n\n\ndef verified_source_files(harness: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[str]]:\n    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []\n    errors: list[str] = []\n    for item in harness.get(\"source_files\", []):\n        if not isinstance(item, dict):\n            errors.append(\"harness source-file entry is not an object\")\n            continue\n        path = Path(str(item.get(\"path\") or \"\"))\n        declared = str(item.get(\"sha256\") or \"\")\n        if not path.is_file():\n            errors.append(f\"harness source file is missing: {path}\")\n            continue\n        actual = sha256_file(path)\n        if actual != declared:\n            errors.append(f\"harness source hash mismatch: {path}\")\n            continue\n        rows.append({\"path\": str(path), \"sha256\": actual})\n    if not rows:\n        errors.append(\"harness has no hash-verified source files\")\n    return rows, errors\n\n\ndef write_weight_stream(path: Path, bindings: list[dict[str, Any]], bits: int = 16) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    import torch\n\n    if bits != 16:\n        raise ValueError(f\"semantic weight stream currently requires fp16 words, got {bits}\")\n    words: list[int] = []\n    tensor_layout = []\n    for tensor_id, binding in enumerate(bindings):\n        tensor_path = Path(str(binding.get(\"path\") or \"\"))\n        if not tensor_path.is_file() or sha256_file(tensor_path) != binding.get(\"file_sha256\"):\n            raise ValueError(f\"real-weight tensor file/hash mismatch: {tensor_path}\")\n        tensor = torch.load(tensor_path, map_location=\"cpu\", weights_only=True)\n        values = tensor_words(tensor, bits)\n        if len(values) % 2:\n            values.append(0)\n        offset = len(words)\n        for index in range(0, len(values), 2):\n            words.append(values[index] | (values[index + 1] << 16))\n        tensor_layout.append(\n            {\n                \"tensor_id\": tensor_id,\n                \"tensor\": binding.get(\"tensor\"),\n                \"tensor_sha256\": binding.get(\"sha256\"),\n                \"word_offset\": offset,\n                \"word_count\": len(words) - offset,\n                \"packing\": \"two_ieee_fp16_values_per_u32_lane0_lsb\",\n            }\n        )\n    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    path.write_text(\"\".join(f\"{word:08x}\\n\" for word in words), encoding=\"ascii\")\n    return {\n        \"path\": str(path),\n        \"sha256\": sha256_file(path),\n        \"word_bits\": 32,\n        \"word_count\": len(words),\n        \"tensor_layout\": tensor_layout,\n    }\n\n\ndef semantic_harness_tb(\n    *,\n    tb_module: str,\n    harness: dict[str, Any],\n    input_vectors: list[dict[str, Any]],\n    expected_output: dict[str, Any],\n    output_path: Path,\n    weight_stream: dict[str, Any] | None,\n    runtime_stream: dict[str, Any] | None,\n) -> str:\n    top_module = sv_identifier(harness.get(\"top_module\"), \"harness top module\")\n    interface = harness.get(\"interface\", {}) if isinstance(harness.get(\"interface\"), dict) else {}\n    clock_port = sv_identifier(interface.get(\"clock_port\"), \"clock port\")\n    reset_port = sv_identifier(interface.get(\"reset_port\"), \"reset port\")\n    input_ports = interface.get(\"inputs\", []) if isinstance(interface.get(\"inputs\"), list) else []\n    output_port = interface.get(\"output\", {}) if isinstance(interface.get(\"output\"), dict) else {}\n    if len(input_ports) != len(input_vectors):\n        raise ValueError(f\"harness input count {len(input_ports)} does not match vectors {len(input_vectors)}\")\n\n    declarations = [\"  reg clock = 0;\", \"  reg reset = 1;\"]\n    connections = [f\"    .{clock_port}(clock)\", f\"    .{reset_port}(reset)\"]\n    drive_lines: list[str] = []\n    handshake_lines: list[str] = []\n    done_terms: list[str] = []\n    for index, (port, vector) in enumerate(zip(input_ports, input_vectors)):\n        if not isinstance(port, dict):\n            raise ValueError(f\"input interface {index} is not an object\")\n        width = int(vector[\"bits\"]) * int(vector[\"lanes\"])\n        declared_width = int(port.get(\"data_width_bits\") or 0)\n        if declared_width != width:\n            raise ValueError(f\"input {index} width {declared_width} does not match encoded vector width {width}\")\n        valid_port = sv_identifier(port.get(\"valid_port\"), f\"input {index} valid\")\n        ready_port = sv_identifier(port.get(\"ready_port\"), f\"input {index} ready\")\n        data_port = sv_identifier(port.get(\"data_port\"), f\"input {index} data\")\n        declarations.extend(\n            [\n                f\"  reg [{width - 1}:0] input_mem_{index} [0:{int(vector['beats']) - 1}];\",\n                f\"  reg input_{index}_valid = 0;\",\n                f\"  wire input_{index}_ready;\",\n                f\"  reg [{width - 1}:0] input_{index}_data = 0;\",\n                f\"  integer input_{index}_accepted = 0;\",\n            ]\n        )\n        connections.extend(\n            [\n                f\"    .{valid_port}(input_{index}_valid)\",\n                f\"    .{ready_port}(input_{index}_ready)\",\n                f\"    .{data_port}(input_{index}_data)\",\n            ]\n        )\n        last_port = port.get(\"last_port\")\n        if last_port:\n            last_port = sv_identifier(last_port, f\"input {index} last\")\n            declarations.append(f\"  reg input_{index}_last = 0;\")\n            connections.append(f\"    .{last_port}(input_{index}_last)\")\n            drive_lines.append(f\"      input_{index}_last = input_{index}_accepted == {int(vector['beats']) - 1};\")\n        drive_lines.extend(\n            [\n int(expected_output[\"lanes\"])\n    if int(output_port.get(\"data_width_bits\") or 0) != output_width:\n        raise ValueError(\"harness output width does not match encoded expected-output output_data_port = sv_identifier(output_port.get(\"data_port\"), \"output data\")\n    declarations.extend(\n        [\n            \"  wire output_valid;\",\n            \"  reg output_ready =     ]\n    )\n    connections.extend(\n        [\n            f\"    .{output_valid_port}(output_valid)\",\n            f\"    .{output_ready_port}(output_ready)\",\n            f\"    .{output_data_port}(output_data)\",\n        ]\n    )\n\n    setup_lines: list[str] = []\n    for index, vector in enumerate(input_vectors):\n        declarations.append(f\"  string input_path_{index} = \"{vector[\"path\"]}\";',\n                f\"    $readmemh(input_path_{index}, input_mem_{index});\",\n            ]\n        )\n    weight_setup: list[str] = []\n  valid_port = sv_identifier(loader.get(\"valid_port\"), \"weight valid\")\n        ready_port = sv_identifier(loader.get(\"ready_port\"), \"weight ready\")\n        data_port =         "bytes": 24606,
        "content": "package spatialaccagent.semantic_harness\n\nimport chisel3._\nimport chisel3.util._\nimport spatialaccagent.templates._\n\nprivate object SemanticShape {\n  val Hidden = 896\n  val Intermediate = 4864\n  val Lanes = 8\n  val Tokens = 16\n  val HiddenBeats = Hidden / Lanes\n  val IntermediateBeats = Intermediate / Lanes\n  val HiddenTotalBeats = Tokens * HiddenBeats\n  val IntermediateTotalBeats = Tokens * IntermediateBeats\n}\n\nprivate class StreamIngress(\n  dataBits: Int,\n  addrBits: Int,\n  beatsPerVector: Int,\n  totalBeats: Int\n) extends Module {\n  require(dataBits > 0)\n  require(addrBits > 0)\n  require(beatsPerVector > 0)\n  require(totalBeats > 0)\n  require(totalBeats % beatsPerVector == 0)\n\n  val io = IO(new Bundle {\n    val enable = Input(Bool())\n    val externalValid = Input(Bool())\n    val externalReady = Output(Bool())\n    val externalData = Input(UInt(dataBits.W))\n    val out = Decoupled(new StreamBeat(StreamSpec(dataBits, addrBits)))\n  })\n\n  private val accepted = RegInit(0.U(addrBits.W))\n  private val featureBeat = accepted % beatsPerVector.U\n  private val active = io.enable && !reset.asBool\n\n  io.out.valid := io.externalValid && active\n  io.externalReady := io.out.ready && active\n  io.out.bits.data := io.externalData\n  io.out.bits.st := featureBeat === 0.U\n Int,\n  seqLen: Int,\n  lanes: Int = 8,\n  elemBits: Int = 16,\n  qkvElemsPerBeat: Int = 8,\n  batchSize: Int = 16\n) {\n  require(hiddenSize == qHeads * headDim, \"attention hidden size must equal qHeads * headDim\")\n  require(qHeads > 0 && kvHeads > 0 && qHeads % kvHeads == 0, \"invalid GQA head grouping\")\n  require(headDim > 0 && seqLen > 0, \"attention dimensions must be positive\")\n  require(elemBits == 16, \"the immutable attention internal element type is IEEE FP16\")\n  require(hiddenSize % lanes == 0, \"hiddenSize must be divisible by output lanes\")\n\n  val qkv: QKVProjectionParams = QKVProjectionParams(\n    hiddenSize,\n    qHeads,\n    kvHeads,\n    headDim,\n    lanes = lanes,\n    elemBits = elemBits,\n    qkvElemsPerBeat = qkvElemsPerBeat,\n <action_contract_examples>
[
  {
    "acceptance_checkers": [
      "case_real_weight_artifacts",
      "case_target_model_reference",
      "case_semantic_testbench"
    ],
    "action_type": "verification_evidence_preparation",
    "consumes": [
      "artifact.input.model_config",
      "artifact.input.numeric_policy",
      "artifact.stage3.pipeline_plan",
      "current case-adapter target checkpoint",
      "generated/memory/dut_weight_binding_manifest.json"
    ],
    "id": "example.prepare_real_model_semantic_verification",
    "on_failure": "treat missing reference, explicit tolerance, semantic harness, or DUT weight consumption as a verification-capability/code-generation blocker; do not run a legacy fallback test or promote the layer.",
    "produces": [
      "verification/real_weights/full_tensor_catalog.json",
      "verification/model_reference/reference_manifest.json",
      "verification/semantic_testbench/semantic_testbench_manifest.json",
      "verification/semantic_testbench/dut_weight_binding_requirements.json"
    ],
    "rationale": "Build immutable semantic evidence from the current case adapter before any hardware correctness claim.",
    "requires_approval": false,
    "stage": "verification",
    "tool_roles": [
      "case_weight_manifest_generate",
      "case_target_model_reference",
      "case_semantic_testbench"
    ]
  },
  {
    "acceptance_checkers": [
      "functional_sim",
      "data_order_trace_check",
      "deadlock_watchdog",
      "real_weight_semantic_evidence_check"
    ],
    "action_type": "real_tool_execution",
    "consumes": [
      "artifact.stage6.verification_artifact_contract",
      "verification/model_reference/reference_manifest.json",
      "verification/semantic_testbench/semantic_testbench_manifest.json",
      "generated/memory/dut_weight_binding_manifest.json",
      "verification/board_simulation/board_simulation_manifest.json"
    ],
    "id": "example.run_real_functional_sim",
    "on_failure": "route simulator evidence to Stage8 repair with the violated SACG constraints; do not proceed to Vivado.",
    "produces": [
      "verification/vcs/case_functional_sim.log",
      "verification/board_simulation/rtl_output.memh",
      "verification/debug_closure/boundary_trace.json",
      "verification/case_diagnostics/vcs_functional_diagnosis.json",
      "verification/semantic_evidence/board_axi_ddr.json"
    ],
    "rationale": "Run a real simulator after static hierarchy and artifact gates pass.",
    "requires_approval": false,
    "stage": "verification",
    "tool_roles": [
      "case_vcs_functional_sim",
      "case_vcs_evidence_analyzer",
      "case_board_semantic_evidence"
    ]
  },
  {
    "acceptance_checkers": [
      "planned_checker.formal_axi_property_check"
    ],
    "action_type": "system_capability_gap",
    "consumes": [
      "artifact.stage6.verification_plan"
    ],
    "id": "example.declare_missing_capability",
    "on_failure": "block promotion until the planned checker is implemented or an approved equivalent exists.",
    "produces": [
      "planned checker implementation task"
    ],
    "rationale": "The design team needs a checker not yet implemented by the multi-agent system.",
    "requires_approval": true,
    "stage": "verification",
    "tool_roles": [
      "planned_tool.formal_axi_property_runner"
    ]
  },
  {
    "acceptance_checkers": [
      "backend_app_shell_target_hint_synthesis_check",
      "backend_bounded_recovery_action_check",
      "human_boundary_check"
    ],
    "action_type": "bounded_recovery",
    "consumes": [
      "artifact.stage9.app_shell_integration_contract",
      "artifact.stage9.app_shell_target_selection_decision",
      "backend_board/case_diagnostics/app_shell_target_discovery_after_hint.json"
    ],
    "id": "example.ambiguous_backend_target_recovery",
    "on_failure": "keep runtime bitstream and board runtime blocked until the target contract has cited evidence or explicit approval",
    "produces": [
      "artifact.stage9.backend_bounded_recovery_actions"
    ],
    "rationale": "Real backend evidence produced multiple plausible shell integration targets, so the design team must not guess.",
    "requires_approval": true,
    "stage": "backend_board",
    "tool_roles": [
      "app_shell_target_hint_synthesis",
      "app_shell_target_discovery_after_hint"
    ]
  }
]
</action_contract_examples>
